description: Every HTTP status code, what it means and when to send it — with the RFC that defines it. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

code.description: One HTTP status code to explain, e.g. 404. Takes precedence over query.

language.description: Language of the meaning and usage text. The official names stay English, as the RFCs write them.

query.description: Search instead of a single code: a number or its first digits ("40" gives 400-409), a class ("4xx"), or words in English or the chosen language ("redirect", "rate limit", "teapot"). Empty with no code returns every registered code.

name: http_status_codes
title: HTTP Status Codes
